h1:
Where to Stay in Nong Khai?
10 Hotels We've Reviewed
Prices Compared Across 3 Sites
heroSub: Ten Nong Khai hotels across every budget — an in-town hotel with a Mekong-view sky bar, a French-garden resort with a pool, a riverside boutique where every room has a balcony, a garden guesthouse on the river, down to riverside stays and a pool resort from ฿400. Covering the Mekong riverfront, the city centre and the Friendship Bridge side. Starting from around ฿400–2,500/night.
introH2: 🏙️ Why does choosing the right base in Nong Khai matter?
introHtml: Nong Khai is a Mekong border town where the main sights line the riverbank. Tha Sadet Market and the riverside walking street are the hub for food, Lao souvenirs and the evening atmosphere. The Mekong riverfront is the heart of town — look across to Laos, wander the river at dawn. The Thai–Lao Friendship Bridge is the crossing to Vientiane and the connection to the Laos–China railway. And the city centre on Mittraphap Road is the mall-and-shops quarter, easy to get around. Many people come to Nong Khai to visit temples, stroll the river, or break the journey before crossing into Laos, then book without checking whether the hotel is actually on the river or a drive away. This guide rounds up 10 Nong Khai hotels we've picked across every tier — from an in-town hotel with a Mekong sky bar and a riverside boutique where every room has a balcony, down to a budget garden guesthouse on the river — each with an honest take from real reviews, prices compared on 3 sites, and direct booking links.
mrtHtml: Nong Khai has no metro, but the town is compact — a Grab or a local cab is cheap and easy. From the railway station and the bus terminal it's a short ride into town and to the riverfront. The main areas in this guide: Mekong riverfront · Tha Sadet Market — wake to the river, walk the market, Lao souvenirs, riverside food (Na Rim Khong, Mut Mee, Baan Sabai, Royal Mekong) · City centre · Mittraphap Road — mall, restaurants, easy to get around (Amanta, Asawann, Tanzeno) · Near the Friendship Bridge — easy crossing to Vientiane and the Laos–China railway (Park & Pool, PP Nongkhai) · Old town — walkable to Tha Sadet Market and the walking street (Pantawee).

entries.name: Amanta Hotel Nongkhai
entries.revCount: 209 reviews · highest score in this list
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Kaew Worawut Rd · city centre, near the river
entries.addr: 999 Moo 1, Kaew Worawut Rd, Nai Mueang, Mueang Nong Khai
entries.storyHtml: The highest score in this list at 9.3 across 209 reviews — Amanta Hotel Nongkhai is a 4-star city-centre hotel with a rooftop sky bar that looks across the Mekong to Laos, opened in 2016 on Kaew Worawut Road, a short walk from the riverfront and Tha Sadet Market. What guests praise most is the sunset view from the sky bar, plus a pool and a leafy koi-pond garden that set it apart from the usual concrete city hotels, with a balcony in nearly every room. Real reviews praise the cleanliness, the friendly service and the varied breakfast — a fit for temple-goers, riverfront wanderers and people breaking the journey into Laos.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: ask for an upper-floor room facing the garden or koi pond for a better feel and to avoid the slight mustiness some ground-floor rooms report — and don't miss the sky bar at sunset, when the Mekong view is at its best.
pros: Highest score in the set, 9.3 across 209 reviews
Rooftop sky bar over the Mekong and Laos, great for sunset
Has a pool and a koi-pond garden, balcony in almost every room
Central location, walk to Tha Sadet Market, free parking
cons: Not right on the river — a short walk to the riverfront
Slight mustiness in some rooms on arrival; the building is showing its age

entries.name: Park & Pool Resort
entries.revCount: 90 reviews · once #1 in Nong Khai on TripAdvisor
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Near the Friendship Bridge · 5-min walk from the railway station
entries.addr: 163/1-3 Moo 3, Soi Dondaeng 3, Sadet Rd, Mi Chai, Mueang Nong Khai
entries.storyHtml: Park & Pool Resort is the resort many call the best value and best atmosphere in Nong Khai — 9.2 across 90 reviews, and once ranked #1 in the town on TripAdvisor. The draw is a leafy French-style garden planted with ferns and orchids, built around a 16x8m outdoor pool, with stand-alone bungalows tucked among the greenery. It's a 5-minute walk from the railway station, on the Friendship Bridge side, with a free station shuttle. Real reviews praise the roomy rooms, the fresh breakfast and the value — a fit for families and people connecting onward to Vientiane.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: for quiet and privacy ask for a garden bungalow and avoid the pool-side rooms on long weekends when it gets busy — and in the cool-season high season, book 2–3 weeks ahead.
pros: Leafy French-garden atmosphere, quiet, unlike a city hotel
Big 16x8m pool, with stand-alone garden bungalows
5-min walk from the station, free shuttle, near the Thai–Lao border
Roomy rooms, fresh breakfast, widely praised value
cons: Not on the Mekong — a ~10-min ride to Tha Sadet Market
Shared pool gets fairly busy on holidays

entries.name: Asawann Hotel Nongkhai
entries.revCount: 161 reviews · attached to Asawann shopping centre
entries.addr: 9 Moo 10, Mittraphap Rd, Pho Chai, Mueang Nong Khai
entries.storyHtml: Asawann Hotel is a good-value 3-star city hotel with a solid 161 reviews, scoring 9.1. Its clear selling point is the location — attached to the Asawann shopping centre on Mittraphap Road, a few steps from restaurants, a 7-Eleven and the town's shops, ideal if you arrive without a car. Rooms are spacious and clean for the price, with free parking. Real reviews single out the polite, friendly staff and a varied, good-value breakfast — a fit for those who value location and walk-out convenience over newness or design.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: room quality here is uneven — when booking or at check-in, ask for a renovated or upper-floor room for more comfort. Use it as a base to walk for food and shopping, then take a 10-minute ride to the riverfront in the evening.
pros: Central, by the mall, walk to a 7-Eleven and restaurants
Polite, friendly staff, good service, a solid 161 reviews
Varied, good-value breakfast
Spacious rooms, low price, free parking
cons: Room quality is uneven — some rooms are dated and due a refresh
Not on the Mekong — a ~10-min ride to Tha Sadet Market

entries.name: Tanzeno Hotel Nong Khai
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Mittraphap Rd · in town, near the Friendship Bridge
entries.addr: Mittraphap Rd, Mi Chai, Mueang Nong Khai
entries.storyHtml: Tanzeno Hotel is a 2019-built boutique hotel that sells roomy rooms for the price — 9.0 across 55 reviews. The thing reviewers agree on most is the space: both bedroom and bathroom feel generous, with comfy beds and strong air-con. Drivers love the wide, easy parking — rare for a city hotel — plus breakfast included and free bikes to borrow. It sits in town on Mittraphap Road, near the Thai–Lao Friendship Bridge, a fit for those driving in or using Nong Khai as a base to cross into Vientiane.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: ask for a higher floor for quiet and a more open outlook, choose the Family Room if there are a few of you (cheaper than two rooms), and borrow a hotel bike to ride to the river at dusk for the most Nong Khai feel.
pros: Rooms larger than average for the town, clean, comfy beds
Wide, easy parking, ideal if you're driving in
Breakfast included in many rates, free bikes to borrow
Near the Friendship Bridge, easy to cross to Vientiane
cons: The hotel is starting to show its age, some furnishings worn
Not on the Mekong — a ~10-min ride to Tha Sadet Market

entries.name: Na Rim Khong River View
entries.revCount: 54 reviews · river-view balcony in every room
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Mi Chai Rd · on the Mekong, by Tha Sadet Market
tags: 🛺 Tuk-tuk shuttle from the car park
entries.addr: 423 Moo 5, Mi Chai Rd, Mekong riverside (Tha Sadet Market), Mueang Nong Khai
entries.storyHtml: Na Rim Khong River View is a boutique that sells a genuinely on-the-water position, with a private balcony in every room — 8.9 across 54 reviews. The building faces straight down to the Mekong, so most rooms open onto a balcony with a view of the river and the Lao bank — sip coffee and watch the boats pass, not a distant view through glass. It's right by Tha Sadet Market, a walk to the walking street. Real reviews praise the view, the balconies and a breakfast so generous many say it lasts till afternoon — a fit for those coming to Nong Khai mainly for the riverside atmosphere.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: when booking, specify a river-facing room with a balcony — the view is the whole point. Cars can't reach the door; you park at a nearby lot, so call ahead with your arrival time so they can send the tuk-tuk to pick you up.
pros: Genuinely on the Mekong, river-view balcony in every room
Right by Tha Sadet Market, walk to the riverside walking street
Generous breakfast, both Thai and Western dishes
Friendly, attentive staff
cons: Pricier than typical Nong Khai stays
Cars can't reach the door — park at the lot and take the shuttle

entries.name: Mut Mee Garden Guest House
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Kaew Worawut Rd · in a garden on the Mekong
entries.addr: 1111/4 Kaew Worawut Rd, Nai Mueang, Mueang Nong Khai
entries.storyHtml: Mut Mee Garden Guest House is the riverside garden guesthouse Nong Khai travellers have talked about for decades — 8.5 across 93 reviews, and ranked #1 among the town's B&Bs and guesthouses on TripAdvisor. The draw is a leafy tropical garden right on the Mekong bank, with thatched salas to watch the sunset across to Laos, plus a riverside restaurant, yoga classes, massage, a bookshop and bike rental — more a little community than just a bed. Rooms range from cheap fan rooms to air-con with en-suite, a 5-minute walk to Tha Sadet Market. Real reviews praise the atmosphere, the location and the value.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: for a comfier night choose an air-con room with an en-suite and ask for one set deeper in the garden — quieter than the walkway-side rooms. Skip the in-house breakfast and walk to nearby Tha Sadet Market, which is cheaper.
pros: Beautiful, leafy Mekong garden, an atmosphere unlike anything else in town
5-minute walk to Tha Sadet Market and the riverfront
Riverside restaurant, yoga, massage, bookshop, bike rental
Great value, with rooms across several tiers
cons: Thin walls — you'll hear neighbours and outside noise
Cheapest rooms are basic, and breakfast is an extra ~฿200

entries.name: PP Nongkhai Resort
entries.revCount: 43 reviews · bungalows with a pool, low price
entries.badge: 🏊 Bungalows with a pool, great value
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Pho Chai area · on the Friendship Bridge side
entries.addr: 758/2 Bo Hin Soi 5, Pho Chai, Mueang Nong Khai
entries.storyHtml: PP Nongkhai Resort is a good-value, clean, quiet bungalow resort for self-drivers — around 8.3 on Booking across 43 reviews. It's a single-storey bungalow place in the Pho Chai area outside the inner town, leafy and unhurried. What earns the score is an outdoor pool and free private parking right at your door — rare at this price. It's on the road out to the Friendship Bridge, about 10–15 minutes from the border. Real reviews praise the cleanliness, comfy beds, kind staff and the value — a fit for families and groups of friends driving in.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: ask for a Deluxe Pool View near the pool for easy swimming — it's only a little more than a standard room. The location is out of town, so without a car have Grab ready for trips into town and to the river, and check whether the rate includes breakfast before booking.
pros: Clean bungalows with an outdoor pool, quiet
Free private parking right at your door, ideal for self-drivers
From just ฿550 — great value for a resort with a pool
On the road out to the Friendship Bridge, easy crossing to Laos
cons: Out of town — hard to get around without a car
Not on the Mekong, about 4 km from Tha Sadet Market

entries.name: Baan Sabai Rim Khong
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Soi Prayungvet · on the Mekong, walk to Tha Sadet Market
entries.addr: 168 Moo 3, Soi Prayungvet, Kaew Worawut Rd, Nai Mueang, Mueang Nong Khai
entries.storyHtml: Baan Sabai Rim Khong is a good-value riverside boutique guesthouse on the Mekong — 8.0 across 110 reviews. It's a small place of about 15 rooms sitting right on the Mekong bank in town; some Deluxe River View rooms have a balcony to look straight out at the river. It's an easy walk to Tha Sadet Market and the riverside restaurants, about 3 km from the Friendship Bridge. Real reviews praise the location, the river view and the friendly staff — a fit for couples and travellers who want to wake to the Mekong on a light budget.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: pay ~฿200–300 more for a Deluxe River View with a balcony — the best-value upgrade here. Ask for an upper-floor room to avoid noise from reception, and walk over to Tha Sadet Market for breakfast nearby.
pros: On the Mekong, river-view rooms with balconies to watch the river
Walk to Tha Sadet Market and the riverside restaurants
Excellent value for a riverside stay
Friendly staff who help with rides and tips
cons: Very simple breakfast — sometimes just toast and 3-in-1 coffee
Rooms look a bit older than the photos; cheapest rooms have no river view

entries.name: Royal Mekong Nongkhai Hotel
entries.badge: 💬 Most reviews · right on the river
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Kaew Worawut Rd · on the Mekong, ~800m from the Friendship Bridge
entries.addr: 222 Kaew Worawut Rd, Mueang Nong Khai
entries.storyHtml: Royal Mekong Nongkhai Hotel is a large 4-star hotel of 200+ rooms that sits right on the Mekong and has the most reviews in this list — 320, scoring 7.6. Its strength is that it's genuinely on the river, not just near it, with an outdoor pool at the water's edge where you swim watching the Mekong and the Lao bank. It's about 800m from the Friendship Bridge with free parking, handy for border crossers. Real reviews praise the roomy rooms, the river view and the riverside pool — but say plainly that it's an older-generation hotel with parts due a refresh.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: specify a River View room or a higher floor facing the river when booking — not every room faces the water and the price gap is small. Use the riverside pool at dawn or dusk for the best light and atmosphere.
pros: Right on the Mekong, many rooms with a river view to Laos
Outdoor pool at the water's edge, nice atmosphere
Most reviews in the set, 320 — plenty of real data
~800m from the Friendship Bridge, free parking
cons: An older, large hotel — parts of the building are due a refresh
Limited breakfast choice; without a car the central night market is a fair way off

entries.name: Pantawee Hotel
entries.revCount: 266 reviews · walk to Tha Sadet Market
entries.badge: 🚶 Old town, walk to the river
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Mi Chai Rd area · old town Nong Khai
entries.addr: 1049 Haisoke Rd (Mi Chai Rd area), Mueang Nong Khai
entries.storyHtml: Pantawee Hotel is an old-town hotel well known to travellers and people crossing to Vientiane, with a strong 266 reviews, scoring 7.4. Its clear selling point is the old-town location — about 800m on foot to Tha Sadet Market, the walking street and the Mekong. It has a pool, an in-house restaurant, free parking and good English-speaking staff who help with tours and border crossings. Real reviews praise the value and the service, but say plainly that it's an older hotel with uneven rooms and cleanliness — a fit for budget travellers who want a walkable base.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: room quality is uneven — ask for a renovated room or a quieter floor when booking, and check the bathroom and bed at check-in before accepting. Use it as a base to wander Tha Sadet Market and the river at dusk before crossing to Vientiane the next day.
pros: Old-town location, walk to Tha Sadet Market and the riverside walking street
Has a pool, an in-house restaurant and free parking
Friendly, good English-speaking staff who help with tours and shuttles
Low price, a strong 266 reviews, good for budget travellers
cons: An older hotel — uneven rooms and cleanliness
Most rooms have a city view, not a Mekong view

adviceTitle: How to pick the right Nong Khai hotel for your trip

advice.head: Want to sleep on the Mekong with a view from the room
advice.bodyHtml: → Na Rim Khong River View ฿2,500, river-view balcony in every room, by Tha Sadet Market · or Royal Mekong ฿1,200, a large hotel right on the river with a poolside on the water

advice.head: On a budget, want the riverfront cheap
advice.bodyHtml: → Mut Mee Garden Guest House ฿400, the legendary riverside garden guesthouse · or Baan Sabai Rim Khong ฿500, river-view rooms with balconies, walk to Tha Sadet Market

advice.head: Want an in-town hotel with a river view
advice.bodyHtml: → Amanta Hotel Nongkhai ฿1,300, a rooftop Mekong-view sky bar, highest score 9.3, walk to Tha Sadet Market

advice.head: Want a pool on a budget
advice.bodyHtml: → Park & Pool Resort ฿900, French garden, 16x8m pool · or PP Nongkhai Resort ฿550, bungalows with a pool and free parking

advice.head: Arriving without a car, want to walk for food and shops
advice.bodyHtml: → Asawann Hotel ฿900, attached to the Asawann shopping centre, walk to a 7-Eleven and restaurants · or Pantawee Hotel ฿650, old town, walk to Tha Sadet Market

advice.head: Driving in, want roomy rooms and easy parking
advice.bodyHtml: → Tanzeno Hotel ฿1,150, roomy rooms, wide parking, near the Friendship Bridge · or PP Nongkhai Resort ฿550, park at your door

advice.head: Crossing to Vientiane or the Laos–China railway
advice.bodyHtml: → Park & Pool Resort ฿900, a 5-min walk from the station, near the border · or Royal Mekong ฿1,200, ~800m from the Friendship Bridge

noteHtml: 📌 Note: all prices are approximate and can change by date and season — always check live rates and compare 3 sites before booking. Nong Khai is a border town where many people break the journey to Vientiane and Laos; during the Naga Fireball / end-of-Buddhist-Lent festival (October) and the cool-season high season (Nov–Jan), rooms fill fast and prices rise, so book 1–2 months ahead. Nong Khai has no metro — a Grab or a local cab is easy. Article by ThailandAddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — common traveller questions about Nong Khai hotels

faq.q: ❓ Which area should I stay in Nong Khai?
faq.a: It depends on your trip. The Mekong riverfront · Tha Sadet Market suits people who want to wake to the river and walk the market and riverside food (Na Rim Khong, Mut Mee, Baan Sabai, Royal Mekong). The city centre · Mittraphap Road suits those who want the mall, restaurants and easy getting around (Amanta, Asawann, Tanzeno). Near the Friendship Bridge suits people crossing to Vientiane or connecting to the Laos–China railway (Park & Pool, PP Nongkhai). All areas are an easy Grab or local cab apart.

faq.q: ❓ How much do Nong Khai hotels cost?
faq.a: Prices vary widely: budget guesthouses and riverside stays start around ฿400–600 a night; in-town 3-star hotels run ฿650–1,150; 4-star hotels and resorts run ฿900–1,300; a riverside boutique with river-view balconies starts around ฿2,500. During the end-of-Buddhist-Lent and Naga Fireball festival and the cool-season high season, prices rise and rooms fill fast.

faq.q: ❓ Which Nong Khai stays are genuinely on the Mekong?
faq.a: Stays that sit on the water or have river-view rooms include Na Rim Khong River View (a river-view balcony in every room, by Tha Sadet Market), Royal Mekong (a large hotel right on the river with a poolside on the water), and Mut Mee and Baan Sabai Rim Khong (budget riverside guesthouses). Amanta is in town but has a rooftop sky bar over the Mekong. If you want a view from the room, specify a River View room when booking.

faq.q: ❓ Coming to Nong Khai to cross to Vientiane — where should I stay?
faq.a: Choose a stay on the Friendship Bridge side for an easy morning departure. Park & Pool Resort is a 5-min walk from the station and near the border, with a free shuttle. PP Nongkhai Resort is on the road out to the bridge, 10–15 minutes from the border. Royal Mekong is about 800m from the bridge, handy for the Laos–China railway. Most offer free parking for self-drivers.

faq.q: ❓ How far ahead should I book a Nong Khai hotel?
faq.a: For ordinary weekdays, 1–2 weeks ahead is enough. But during the end-of-Buddhist-Lent and Naga Fireball festival (October) and the cool-season high season (Nov–Jan), in-town and riverside hotels fill very fast and prices rise — book 1–2 months ahead, especially the limited river-view rooms.

faq.q: ❓ Which site is cheapest for booking Nong Khai hotels?
faq.a: Prices on each site (Agoda, Booking.com, Trip.com) differ by promotion at any given time, so compare all three before booking — each review page in this guide has links to compare prices, which can save you a few hundred baht a night.
